Tag.description: A key-value pair to associate with a resource.

schema.description: Resource Type definition for AWS::EC2::DeclarativePoliciesReport. A read-only resource representing an EC2 declarative-policies account status report, which is a report generation job: for every account in an AWS Organizations scope it reports the current status of each attribute a declarative policy can govern.

Arn.description: The ARN of the account status report.

EndTime.description: The time when the report generation ended. Absent while the report is running and populated in every terminal state.

S3Bucket.description: The name of the Amazon S3 bucket where the report is located. The bucket must be in the same Region where the report generation request is made.

S3Prefix.description: The prefix for your S3 object.

StartTime.description: The time when the report generation started.

Status.description: The current status of the report.

Tags.description: Any tags assigned to the report.

TargetId.description: The root ID, organizational unit ID, or account ID the report covers. Format: r-ab12 for a root, ou-ab12-cdef1234 for an organizational unit, or 123456789012 for an account.
